_doc: THROWAWAY firewall used to prove the provisioning path end to end before any real FW is reseeded (issue #93). Safety by construction: the ONLY NIC on a shared segment is OOB (10.6.239.197, verified free); trunk/FAB sit on the unused `cctv` VNet and every address outside OOB is in 10.99.0.0/16, which the platform does not use; the seed carries NO wan/wan2 section at all and both uplink flags are off, so net2/net3 come up link_down and no ISP identity exists to dial. Destroy it when the run is done: `qm stop 197 && qm destroy 197`.

fab._doc: On the unused cctv VNet, not vmbrFAB, and in 10.99.0.0/16 — it cannot collide with the real fabric VLAN 600.
